items.question: Which additional epithets identify the goddess as Kullā, Kurukullā, Kullukā, and bestower of kula desires?
premises: The verse continues an enumeration of divine epithets.
Kullā, Kurukullā, and Kullukā are named as identities of the goddess.
The epithet kulakāmadā attributes the granting of kula-related desires to her.
items.inference: The goddess is identified by the names Kullā, Kurukullā, and Kullukā and characterized as the giver of kula desires.
uncertainties: The precise ritual or doctrinal distinctions among Kullā, Kurukullā, and Kullukā are not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: She is Kullā, and Kurukullā, and Kullukā, the giver of the desires of the kula.
